description: This file defines a React testing utility class for Three.js objects within a React Three Fiber context, including functions to create virtual instances, wrap fibers, and find nodes based on criteria.

classes.name: ReactThreeTestInstance
classes.description: A class representing a test instance of a Three.js object within React Three Fiber, providing methods to access properties, children, and perform searches.

methods.name: createVirtualInstance
methods.description: Creates a virtual wrapper instance for a THREE.Object3D and its children, used for testing purposes.

methods.name: wrapFiber
methods.description: Wraps an Instance fiber into a ReactThreeTestInstance, with caching to avoid duplicates.
